description: A change to one or more settings, made in one act.

agreement.description: What this reading names itself, part by part.

regenerates.description: Every service whose entry the change regenerates.

restarts.description: Every running service the change restarts.

settings.description: Each setting the act moves, in name order.

starts.description:
Every service held back that the change starts, having given the last thing it
waited for.

unrestarted.description: Why the services it restarts were not restarted, where they were not.

waiting.description: The services held back once the change is made, each with what it waits for.
